title: The Methods of the Sima — Sima fa (English)
summary: A complete English reading of the Methods of the Sima: Benevolence the Root, The Duty of the Son of Heaven, Determining Rank, Strict Positioning and Employing Numbers — five chapters, 3,420 characters, one of the Seven Military Classics and the oldest surviving layer of Chinese military thought, entered in the Han bibliography not among the military writers but under the classics, in the section on rites. Collated character by character against the Sibu congkan facsimile of the Song-copied manuscript from the Qu family library at Changshu and against the Siku quanshu text.
